answer: I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Parchment layer goat mark stretched on the cutting table is that proof: each goat is a measured skin yield plus a parchmenter's signature. One agent spends 18 minutes and is done; the farm spends 12888 minutes and ends with nothing to sell. Ask the panel what it trusts: the jetty it can verify, the wharf it can count, the knoll it can date — and the farm offers none of the three. The toy shop's archive keeps the proof long after the epoch closes, so a forgery has nowhere quiet to age.
